label: Templated display fonts
description: Trendy display fonts like Space Grotesk used as the page default.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: A face from the list (Space Grotesk, Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Bricolage Grotesque, Sora, Young Serif, Bodoni, Syne; list taken from an r/UXDesign thread) is the heading font or carries >= 25% of body text

label: Two fonts/colors mixed in the hero
description: One headline word set apart with a different font, italic, or color.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: H1 >= 32px and <= 140 chars containing a run with a different family, an italic, a different solid colour, or gradient-clipped text

label: VibeCode Purple accent
description: Indigo or violet accent on buttons and links.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: >= 1 filled element (background, border or gradient stop) with HSL hue 250-300, saturation > 0.25, lightness 0.15-0.85, alpha >= 0.3; outline and text-only purple do not count

label: Gradient-heavy backgrounds / gradient text on hero
description: Gradient backgrounds, or gradient-filled headline text.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: Hero H1 with background-clip: text over a gradient, or >= 4-5 elements with a visible (non-transparent) gradient background

label: Accent stripe on cards (top or left edge)
description: A colored stripe along the top or left edge of cards.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: Card-sized box (>= 40x20) with a 2-10px top or left border covering >= 60% of the edge, colour saturation >= 0.2; blockquote, footer, button, hr and table parts excluded

label: Glassmorphism
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: backdrop-filter blur >= 2px on a card-sized panel (150-820 wide, 40-900 tall) with background alpha 0.02-0.9; full-width sticky bars treated separately

label: Large colored glows / colored box-shadows
description: A colored glow behind buttons or cards.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: >= 2 elements whose box-shadow has blur >= 15px in a saturated colour

label: Sidebar/nav with emoji icons
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: >= 40% of >= 3 sidebar links contain emoji, or >= 3 nav items do

label: Centered hero set in Inter / generic sans
description: A centered hero set in Inter or a default sans-serif.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: Centered H1 with >= 40% of the hero region centered, or >= 60% of above-fold text centered, in Inter or a generic sans

label: Perma dark mode look (dark bg + muted grey text)
description: Dark background with muted grey body text.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: Body text (12-20px, weight <= 600) mostly on surfaces with luminance < 0.2, and >= 12% of samples below AAA contrast (fallback paths: >= 35% of the fold dark and >= 20% below AAA; or >= 70% of >= 20 samples on dark)

label: Numbered step sequence (1, 2, 3 ...)
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: A run of >= 3 consecutive step numbers ("1", "01.", "Step 1") at >= 14px or inside a >= 24px badge

label: Stat banner row (10K+ users · 99.9% uptime ...)
description: A row of big stats like 10K+ users or 99.9% uptime.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: A row >= 300px wide with 3-6 children whose big text (>= 22px, <= 10 chars) is numeric with k/m/%/x/+ suffixes; bare ordinals and currency excluded

label: Headline badge (pill above the H1)
description: A small pill label above the headline.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: Within 220px above the H1, a 40-600 x 16-56px element of 3-80 chars with a tinted background (alpha >= 0.05) or a border (alpha >= 0.15), or a compact small-caps eyebrow

label: Generic FAQ accordion at the bottom of the page
description: A collapsible FAQ section near the bottom.
rule (from src/patterns/<id>.js, summari: In the bottom half, a heading matching FAQ / frequently asked questions / common questions with >= 3 collapsible question items
